_what: Generic machine layout and engine protocol limits. Product identity, starting account rows, engine file names and signed feed addresses are caller inputs. `caddy_front_door` is the Caddy a front-door computer runs (a layout whose caddy row has `front_door`): release v2.11.9 built with only github.com/pberkel/caddy-storage-redis v1.9.0 (both Apache-2.0; `xcaddy build v2.11.9 --with github.com/pberkel/caddy-storage-redis@v1.9.0`, CGO off, the same bytes on every build), one file per `uname -m`, fetched from `url` and refused unless its SHA-256 is `sha256`, installed at `binary`.

machine._what: What set-up-the-machine.sh installs: the apt packages, and the node release each unit node_bin folder gets when it has none (from nodejs.org's SHASUMS256.txt for that release, read 2026-11-13).
